:::{#lem-wilks-taylor}
#### Quadratic approximation to the log-likelihood

Let $\param$ be a scalar parameter,
and suppose the MLE $\hthml$ maximizes $\llik$
at an interior point of the parameter space,
where $\llik$ is twice differentiable.
Then the log-likelihood near $\hthml$ is approximately quadratic:

$$\llik(\param_0) \approx \llik(\hthml) + \frac{1}{2}\hess(\hthml)(\param_0 - \hthml)^2$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-wilks-taylor.

:::
